in_sanskrit.name: चन्दनिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is as beautiful as the moon.

in_hindi.name: चन्दनिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has the color of silver like the moon.

in_tamil.name: சந்தனிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who brings light, like the moon.

in_telugu.name: చందనిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is for the moon.

in_marathi.name: Chandanika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandanika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Chandan, which refers to sandalwood. Represents the softness and coolness of moonlight.

in_bengali.name: Chandanika
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chandanika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Chandan, which refers to sandalwood. Represents the softness and coolness of moonlight.
